description: The class of each of the 44 BitPerm fixtures in tests/fixtures/bitperm/mappings, worked out by hand from PRD 20.2: the 15 identity, reverse and swap-halves patterns of widths 8 to 128 and the 8-bit rotation test map read every input exactly once through a plain source and are permutations; every other fixture has a don't-care, a constant or a duplicated input and is a routing.
